summary: Implemented the driver, artifact cache, factory wiring and generality checks. a100c/factory.py: make_compiler() returns FactoryCompiler(Compiler) with the T015 basic-pass seam (constprop/copyprop/strength_reduction/cse/licm/dce between TIR verification and lowering), the compile_case(case)->artifact protocol consumed by a100_support/native_device.py with arguments ('--bundle','{bundle}','--threads','{threads}'), an artifact cache key = the driver's identity + pass configuration (A100C_PASS_<NAME>=off switches honored; all-off is byte-identical to the plain driver), A100C_CACHE_DIR isolation and per-pass trace recorded in the artifact marker; .env wires A100_COMPILER_FACTORY=a100c.factory:make_compiler so a100_support.native_device.make_device() constructs the native device. tools/run_scan.py: enumerates cases with the corpus's own harness (manifest paths -> manifest_specs -> golden.load_or_build_spec = load_operator + make_case), groups by the corpus meta-tier compile identity, stages/executes/compares through the native device protocol under A100_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT with a SIGALRM case budget (timeout rows, never waits; per-case fault isolation), compares with opslib.compare.compare_case reading comparator/rtol/atol/equal_nan/quantized_interval/allclose_sign_invariant and the reference from the case (integer/index/boolean exact, never widened), writes input-regression/v1 manifest (regression-prepare) and report rows (regression-record) with resource_evidence flags on representative rows and full QEMU-plugin resource capture (instruction counts, worker observation, listing/artifact bindings), supports journal/resume without recompiling, and emits the acceptance summary (compile count vs identity census, cache-hit speed). tools/check_no_name_dispatch.py: static scan (file-identity literals; name-shaped branch positions) over the pipeline below the frontend plus tools/run_scan.py, behavioral name-generality probe (one operator under two names -> identical emitted bodies), static+dynamic import inspection (no torch, no reference device on the compile path; the prepared transport's dtype converter is reported, the reference device/backend never loads). tools/check_numeric_policy.py: static (no rtol/atol override) plus executed probes for tolerance, integer exactness, reference-from-case, comparator forms and per-case manifest policies. a100c/tests/test_driver_cache.py: 26 executed checks over the factory protocol, cold/warm/resume accounting and fault isolation. All three tests exit 0; both --witness modes exit nonzero (injected operator-name branch caught; widened tolerance caught). Durable evidence under docs/compiler-agent/TASK_EVIDENCE/T017/: the full-corpus input-regression/v1 manifest (2734 cases, 2116 identities, group totals suite/dev 2192 + suite/perf 542, validated against the engine's validate_manifest), a corpus-group run (35 cases / 21 identities, cold 21 compiles == 21 identities, all 35 PASS at 2 threads; warm 0 compiles / 35 cache hits), mixed-status and perf-tier slices recording located compile refusals honestly, and the test log.
